description: 2-storey front extensions and a single storey rear extension involving extension to existing garage and 2x rear dormers with rooflights.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanGround Floor Plan Existing First Floor Plan ExistingLoft Plan ExistingRoof Plan ExistingSection AA Side Elevation ExistingFront and Rear Elevation Existing Ground Floor Plan Proposed Rev A First Floor Plan Proposed Rev A Loft Floor Plan Proposed Rev A Roof Plan Proposed Rev A Section AA Side Elevation Proposed Rev AFront and Rear Elevation Proposed Rev A Design and Access StatementSuDs Proforma Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The proposed glazed windows on the flank elevations (First and second floor) shall be fitted with obscure glazing to a minimum of Pilkington Level 3 (or equivalent) and shall be non-opening below a height of 1.7m above the finished internal floor level. The windows shall be retained as such thereafter.Reason: To protect the privacy and amenity of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with relevant local planning policies.
